topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 26 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 5 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
